config.shulkersort.title: ShulkerSort Settings
config.shulkersort.auto_label.tooltip: Automatically rename shulker boxes after sorting (e.g. 'Blocks #1', 'Ores #2')
config.shulkersort.include_loose_items.t: Also sort loose items from your inventory into shulker boxes (disabled by default)
config.shulkersort.overflow_mode.tooltip:
What happens when there are more items than shulker box slots available.

Fill: Boxes are filled across categories until full — mixed content is allowed when space is tight. Remaining items stay in inventory.

Dominant: Each box is dedicated to one category only. Only the top categories (by item count) are sorted; items from other categories stay in inventory.
config.shulkersort.loose_item_ignore_tag: Items with this text in their name will not be sorted into shulker boxes (e.g. rename an item to '[KEEP] Diamond Sword')
config.shulkersort.locked_tag.tooltip: Shulker boxes with this text in their name will be skipped during sorting
config.shulkersort.tooltip_enabled.toolt: Show shulker box contents when hovering over them
config.shulkersort.tooltip_max_lines.too: Maximum number of item lines shown in the tooltip (1-27)
config.shulkersort.enable_chat_notificat: Show chat messages when sorting completes or fails
Play a sound when sorting completes successfully
config.shulkersort.enable_hud_overlay.to: Show an animated 'Sorting...' overlay on the HUD during sorting
